newsitem.title: UK: PRESS-DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS-DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 24.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Islamic summit in Pakistan calls for preventing Israel from building settlements in Jerusalem.
- Iranian president says there was full understanding with Saudi Arabian Crown Prince Abdullah. The two leaders met in Pakistan on the sideline of an Islamic summit.
- Assets of foreign banks in Jordan stand at $6 billion.
- A new development investment fund in Jerusalem to support Palestinians.
- Islamic summit calls for linking relations with Israel with achieving progress in the Middle East peace process.
- Kuwaiti court to pass its verdicts on Kuwaiti Tankers Company's fraud case next month.
- Saudi's Zamil company to build an iron plant in Egypt.
- French bank holds negotiations with Qatar to finance a gas project.
